ios.desc:
Poolsuite is the ultimate summer music player. 

Grab another Banana Daiquiri and pick from a number of sun-drenched music channels, each lovingly curated with the sole purpose of lifting your spirits.

Discover the all-new Poolsuite V3 portable mobile application!

Proudly featuring:
* A completely reinvented design
* Hundreds of new tracks across 7 channels
* Mixtapes now available on mobile
* A full CarPlay integration
* Our new 24/7, non-stop Poolsuite ON-AIR radio stream
* Customizable themes to match the app's interface to your liking

All the love,
Team Poolsuite

--

"A retro digital oasis for your summer" – The Verge

"A project of pure fun and joy" – It's Nice That

Also seen in Harpers Bazaar, TechCrunch, Vanity Fair & more.
